articles.title: 5 insightful analyst questions from Plexus’s Q3 earnings call
articles.summary: Plexus’ third quarter performance surpassed Wall Street’s expectations. Management attributed the revenue and margin outperformance to robust demand across healthcare, industrial, and aerospace segments, underpinned by strong operational execution and supply chain responsiveness. CEO Todd Kelsey highlighted the company's "remarkable strength in the defense and unmanned subsectors" and pointed to new program ramps and market share gains as critical contributors.

articles.title: PLXS Q3 deep dive: demand strength, operating efficiency, and future growth priorities
articles.summary: Electronic manufacturing services company Plexus (NASDAQ:PLXS) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q4 2026), with sales up 34.8% year on year to $1.43 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($1.44 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 5% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.84 per share was 11.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
